Substituting into y = −x + 6 gives x − 10 = −x + 6, so x = 8 and y = −2. Thus P = (8, −2).

Check: PO² = 64 + 4 = 68 and PA² = (8−10)² + (−2+10)² = 4 + 64 = 68, so PA = PO.
